summary: Tractor Supply Company (TSCO) acquired VIP Petcare (operating as VIP Petcare and PetVet) from PetIQ, a Bansk Group company, as announced in an 8-K filed May 28, 2026. VIP Petcare is the largest U.S. mobile veterinary care provider, operating in ~2,700 retail locations, including 1,700 Tractor Supply stores, serving over 1 million pets annually. Terms—price, premium, and consideration—were not disclosed. The acquisition strengthens Tractor Supply's pet health platform by integrating veterinary services, pharmacy, and retail. No board recommendation or advisors named. The deal is expected to close pending regulatory approvals; watch for integration updates and any antitrust review.
